ValidationRule.description: If the Account has a Separate Legal Entity/Tax ID value of "Yes" then Tax ID field is required to move Stage to Legal. BOPI-460 Criteria from Legal to Verbal, added system user bypass BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping. BOPI-943
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", Pricebook2.Name = 'CPQ', Probability > 0.80, ISBLANK(Account.Tax_Id__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Tax ID must be populated on the Opportunity's Account
